column12: Ultral-low loading of Pt-decorated Ni electrocatalyst, manufacturing method of the same and anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer using the same
column13: Provided is an electrocatalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis, including a carbonaceous material, and nickel electrodeposited on the carbonaceous material, wherein nickel is partially substituted with platinum and the substitution with platinum provides increased hydrogen evolution activity as compared to the same electrocatalyst before substitution with platinum. Also provided are a method for preparing the electrocatalyst and an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer using the same. The nickel electrocatalyst coated with an ultralow loading amount of platinum for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis shows excellent hydrogen evolution activity and has a small thickness of catalyst, thereby providing high mass transfer and high catalyst availability. In addition, the electrocatalyst uses a particle-type electrode to facilitate emission of hydrogen bubbles generated during hydrogen evolution reaction and oxygen bubbles generated during oxygen evolution reaction, and requires low cost for preparation to provide high cost-efficiency.

column12: FABRICATION OF REINFORCED ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANES
column13: Methods of preparing reinforced anion exchange membranes are provided, as well as produced membranes and corresponding devices utilizing the membranes. Methods comprise compounding a halide -functionalized polymer (selected to react with amines to yield anion-conducting quaternary amine groups) with thermoplastic polymer(s) (selected to support and/or reinforce the membrane), and with copolymer(s) (selected to enhance the compounding of the polymers) - by heating, mixing and cooling - to form blend pellets, extruding the blend pellets to form a blend film, cross-linking polymer(s), and functionalizing the blend film to prepare the anion exchange membrane. Functionalization comprises a quaternization step comprising reacting halogen groups of the first polymer with tertiary amines to produce the quaternary amine groups with ion-exchange functionality. Reinforced anion exchange membranes are provided, which are produced by the disclosed methods, functionalized to yield a membrane for fuel cell(s), electrolyzer(s), reversible electrochemical device(s), desalination unit(s), etc.

column12: Polyfluorene-based ionomer, anion exchange membrane, method for preparing the polyfluorene-based ionomer and method for fabricating the anion exchange membrane
column13: A novel polyfluorene-based ionomer, an anion exchange membrane, a method for preparing the polyfluorene-based ionomer, and a method for fabricating the anion exchange membrane are proposed. The polyfluorene-based ionomer contains no aryl ether bonds in the polymer backbone and includes piperidinium groups incorporated into the repeating units. The anion exchange membrane is fabricated from the polyfluorene-based ionomer. The anion exchange membrane has good thermal and chemical stability, excellent mechanical properties, and high ion conductivity. Due to these advantages, the anion exchange membrane can be applied as a membrane for an alkaline fuel cell and to a binder for an alkaline fuel cell or water electrolysis.

column12: ELECTROLYSIS CELL AND ELECTROLYSIS APPARATUS
column13: An electrolytic cell of the present disclosure includes a first separator, a second separator, an anion exchange membrane disposed between the first separator and a second separator, a cathode disposed between the first separator and the anion exchange membrane, and an anode disposed between the second separator and the anion exchange membrane. The first separator includes a flow path for supplying an electrolyte to the cathode, and at the cathode, at least part of the electrolyte supplied from the flow path is consumed to generate hydrogen and hydroxide ions. column12: WATER ELECTROLYZER WITH CATION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE
column13: An alkaline water electrolyzer (AWE) incorporates a cation-exchange membrane (CEM) instead of a conventional porous diaphragm or an anion-exchange membrane used in the conventional AWE. The corresponding change in the nature of the charge carrier from the hydroxyl anion (OH_) in the conventional AWE to an alkali cation (A+) has a substantial effect on the electrochemistry and performance of the resulting CEM-alkaline water electrolyzer (CEM-AWE). The water electrolysis device combines advantages of: 1) non-PGM (precious group metal) catalysts involved in L-AWE (liquid alkaline water electrolyzer) and in AEM-AWE (anion exchange membrane-AWE), and 2) higher efficiency, differential pressure operation, responsiveness, and long-life of PEM-WE (proton-exchange membrane water electrolyzer). The novel water electrolyzer combines advantages of the two in the CEM-AWE involving non-PGM catalysts, graphite/SS PTLs and bipolar plates. Conventional approaches to electrolysis based hydrogen generation have not employed a CEM in an AWE.

column12: PROCESS AND APPARATUS FOR PRECIPITATING CATIONIC METAL HYDROXIDES AND THE RECOVERY OF SULFURIC ACID FROM ACIDIC SOLUTIONS
column13: An electric current is passed through an acidic solution containing one or more soluble metal salts in an electrolytic cell divided by an anion exchange membrane. The acidic solution is fed into the cathode compartment whereby the passage of electric current at sufficient voltage causes the generation of hydrogen at the cathode. This gives rise to a localized very highly polarized region at the cathode resulting in a localized effective high relative pH. This causes the metal cation species to precipitate as a hydroxide (or oxide) species and electroadsorption/electrocoagulation causes the finely precipitated hydroxide (or oxide) species to adhere to the cathode. Electrodialytic transport of the liberated acid anions across the anion exchange membrane selectively removes the acid anions. Oxygen and hydrogen ions are formed by hydrolysis as the counter-reaction at the anode. Hydrogen ions combine with the anions to regenerate sulfuric acid. This enables the recovery of cationic metal species within a solution in which the bulk pH would not ordinarily allow hydroxide formation, while simultaneously regenerating sulfuric acid. The anion exchange membrane keeps the acid anion separate from the metal and acid solution so as to enable the concentration and recovery of sulfuric acid.

column12: Management system for changing anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack and control method thereof
column13: The replacement management system for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack and a method for controlling the same are disclosed to replace a water electrolysis stack at an appropriate timing. The replacement management system for the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack comprises: a plurality of water electrolysis stacks arranged in parallel to produce hydrogen; and a control unit controlling the plurality of water electrolysis stacks. The control unit calculates a difference between a density measurement value of water and an electrolyte supplied to the plurality of water electrolysis stacks and a density measurement value of oxygen and the electrolyte discharged from the plurality of water electrolysis stacks to convert a calculated difference into an absolute value. When the absolute value is equal to or less than a set value, the control unit determines that a replacement target has a presence among the plurality of water electrolysis stacks. Furthermore, the control unit calculates a difference between temperature measurement values at a front end and a rear end of each of the water electrolysis stacks to convert a calculated difference into an absolute value. When the absolute value is equal to or less than the set value, the control unit determines a corresponding water electrolysis stack satisfying a condition as the replacement target, and operates an alarm signal so that a manager is capable of performing a replacement work.

column12: GREEN HYDROGEN PRODUCTION ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) ASSISTANT
column13: A green hydrogen production system using an AI operator assistant. Electrolysis sensors collect operating conditions of an automated electrolysis system. An artificial intelligence (AI) electrolysis prediction engine uses the operating conditions to model electrolysis. The AI electrolysis prediction engine models electrolysis using a both first principles model and machine learning models of one or more degradation factors, such as electrolyzer degradation or electro-osmatic drag. The AI electrolysis prediction engine hybridizes the models to generate initial set point scenarios for the electrolysis process. An AI operator assistant receives process characteristics from the operator, which are used to select a set point scenario. column12: Self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, and particularly discloses a self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The poly (aryl piperidine) polymer is selected as a main chain without an ether bond, the cyclic piperidinium is selected as a cationic group, the chemical stability of the membrane material can be effectively improved, the free volume of the interior of the membrane material is increased by introducing a meta-terphenyl monomer with a bent conformation into a polymer structural unit, ion transmission is facilitated, and the membrane material has a good application prospect. And a self-crosslinking network is introduced to further promote the formation of an ionic conduction high-speed channel, and meanwhile, the excessive swelling of the membrane is limited, so that the ionic conductivity and mechanical stability of the membrane are improved. The prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.

column12: Preparation method of modified polyphenyl ether anion exchange membrane with multiple ion transport sites
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a modified polyphenyl ether anion exchange membrane with multiple ion transport sites, and aims to solve the technical problems of low ionic conductivity and insufficient dimensional stability of the existing anion exchange membrane. The core innovation is as follows: grafting modification is performed on polyphenyl ether (PPO) by adopting an imidazole grafting agent with brominated sites, and a large number of quaternary ammonium cation groups are firstly constructed through reaction of imidazole groups and brominated polyphenyl ether (BPPO); the subsequently introduced cross-linking agent has dual reaction activity, not only can be subjected to cross-linking reaction with a BPPO long chain to form a network structure, but also can be further subjected to quaternization reaction with bromination sites of imidazole groups, and a large number of quaternary ammonium cation groups are additionally generated through a'grafting pre-modification and cross-linking dual reaction 'synergistic mechanism. The ionic conductivity of the prepared anion exchange membrane can reach 88.6 mS/cm to 138 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C, the membrane thickness is uniform (114-148 microns), the process is simple, industrial amplification is easy, and the anion exchange membrane is suitable for electrochemical devices such as water electrolysis hydrogen production, fuel cells and the like.

column13: A system for producing clean hydrogen and clean hydrogen derived products using water electrolysis and time correlated renewable power whereby the operation of the electrolysis is optimized for using time correlated renewable power amongst other factors. column12: Preparation method and application of anti-reverse current self-supporting electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an electrode, in particular to a preparation method and application of an anti-reverse current self-supporting electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production. The self-supporting (NiCoFe) 9S8 electrode is constructed by adopting a directional solid-phase synthesis strategy to overcome the challenge of performance degradation of the electrolytic cell. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, depositing a precursor solution of FeS2 and CoCl2 on a nickel felt substrate, and then carrying out annealing treatment to obtain uniformly grown (NiCoFe) 9S8; the method not only ensures uniform distribution of multiple metal components, but also constructs firm chemical bonding and efficient charge transfer between the catalyst layer and the conductive substrate through solid-phase interface reaction, and effectively avoids interface impedance caused by introduction of an additional binder. Therefore, high-current-density water electrolysis hydrogen production under intermittent fluctuation power supply is realized. In 1M KOH, the cell voltage is almost not attenuated when the electrode stably operates for 2000h at 500mAcm <-2 >.

column12: Gas diffusion cathode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production as well as preparation and application of gas diffusion cathode
column13: The invention relates to a gas diffusion cathode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method of the gas diffusion cathode. The gas diffusion cathode is composed of a hydrophobic conductive substrate such as carbon paper or carbon cloth and the like and a catalytic layer, and the catalytic layer takes nickel-based non-noble metal powder and at least one of alloys or derivatives of the nickel-based non-noble metal powder and the alloys as catalytic active components. One or more of carbon powder, carbon nanotubes, carbon nanofibers, graphene, nano graphite powder and the like are used as conductive agents, and polytetrafluoroethylene, polyvinylidene fluoride or perfluorosulfonic acid resin is used as binding agents, so that the gas diffusion cathode is formed. According to the gas diffusion cathode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, nickel-based non-noble metal active components are deposited on a conductive substrate of a porous composite structure, the preparation process is simple, an electrode with a uniform catalyst can be obtained, and compared with the similar technology, the gas diffusion cathode has the obvious advantages of high catalyst utilization rate and high current density; the cathode is applied to various water electrolysis electrochemical reduction reactors or electrolytic tanks.

column12: REACTOR THAT PRODUCES HYDROGEN BY REDUCTION OF HYDRONIUM IONS PRESENT IN THE CHEMICAL EQUILIBRIUM IN WATER AND BY OXIDATION OF THE ORGANIC MOLECULES FOUND IN EXCREMENT
column13: An electrochemical reactor designed to increase the efficiency of hydrogen production from faeces and urine (excrement) is disclosed. Said reactor comprises two half-cells separated in a selective manner, a membrane systems separating the half-cells (comprising a proton-exchange and an anion-exchange membranes) and a system of electrical bridges that allow two mutually perpendicular electrical fields to be formed, with the electrical field in the horizontal direction between the two half-cells being greater than the vertical electrical field generated within the anode. The half-cells have a configuration of two resistances in series, which allows the potential of each compartment to be controlled in an independent and complementary manner by adjusting the conductivity of the solutions in the half-cells. Said configuration allows the consumption of energy to form hydrogen to be significantly reduced in comparison with conventional electrolytic cells using water in an alkaline medium by combining the chemical processes of electrolysis (anode) and the law of chemical equilibrium (cathode). International patent classification: Electrolytic production of hydrogen or oxygen (C25B1/04) - Production of hydrogen or gaseous mixtures containing hydrogen by decomposition of gaseous or liquid organic compounds (C01B3/22) Technological sector: Chemical processes.

column12: Megawatt anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated system
column13: The utility model relates to a megawatt anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated system which comprises an electrolytic bath subsystem comprising a plurality of large standard AEM electrolytic baths and is used for water electrolysis hydrogen production. The electrolyte circulation subsystem is used for providing electrolyte and maintaining circulation; the oxygen treatment subsystem is used for drying and dehydrogenating oxygen; the drying and purifying subsystem is used for drying, deoxidizing and purifying the hydrogen; the purging subsystem is used for purging the residual gas; the power supply and distribution subsystem is used for supplying power; the heat dissipation subsystem is used for cooling and heat dissipation; and the centralized control subsystem is used for controlling the whole integrated system. According to the utility model, the centralized control subsystem is adopted to realize remote control and real-time monitoring on the whole integrated system, so that the whole integrated system is in an optimal operation state, and the efficiency and the dynamic response rate are effectively improved; according to the utility model, the purging system is adopted to purge residual gas, so that the safety of the system is improved; and the low-concentration alkaline liquid is adopted, and hydrogen is removed from oxygen, so that the environmental protection property is effectively improved.

column12: Multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX and method for realizing coupled hydrogen production by using same
column13: The invention discloses a multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX and a method for realizing coupled hydrogen production by using the catalyst. According to the invention, the multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX with high stability and high performance is prepared by constructing V-doped VSA-CoNX, and the catalyst can realize hydrogen production by coupling multiple anion exchange membrane electrolytic cells. Particularly, when VSA-CoNX is used as an anode and a cathode, and hydrogen is produced by coupling a hydrazine assembled anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) electrolytic bath at ampere-level current density (1A cm <-2 >), only 0.21 V ultra-low voltage is needed, which means that the hydrazine assisted AEMWE is used for producing the same amount of hydrogen, only 11.17% of energy consumption of traditional water electrolysis is needed, only 0.506 kWhNm <-3 > H2 is needed, and the hydrogen production efficiency is greatly improved. Therefore, the hydrogen production cost is greatly reduced to 0.11 dollars per kilogram. Therefore, the multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX disclosed by the invention can be used for remarkably reducing the hydrogen production cost. In addition, experiments prove that the degradation rate of the hydrazine-containing electrolyte can exceed 95% within two hours, which shows that the hydrazine-containing electrolyte also has excellent wastewater degradation capacity.

column12: Six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
column13: The invention discloses a six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the field of alkaline fuel cells and electrolyzed water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: introducing tri (4-carbazole-9-yl phenyl) amine with six branching sites into a polymer main chain as a branching unit, and carrying out Friedel-Crafts alkylation copolymerization on the branched unit, p-terphenyl and N-methyl-4-piperidone under the catalysis of superacid to prepare a six-arm star-shaped branched polymer main chain; and performing quaternization on a piperidine ring in the main chain through a Michaku reaction to obtain the target anion exchange membrane. According to the star-shaped branched structure disclosed by the invention, the free volume in the membrane is obviously increased, and a micro-phase separation structure with larger size and stronger connectivity is induced to be formed; the anion exchange membrane has high hydroxyl conductivity, excellent alkali stability, good mechanical performance and outstanding fuel cell and water electrolysis performance, and has wide application prospects in the field of electrochemical energy devices.

The piperidine ring is suspended outside the aryl main chain in the polymer, the rigid structure of the piperidine ring is reserved, and the anion transmission rate and chemical stability are further improved. According to the polymer structure, modification of the polymer is realized by using strategies such as copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, hyperbranched and the like, and the polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed.

column12: ELECTROCHEMICAL METHOD, APPARATUS AND SYSTEM WITH IMPROVED PRODUCTION EFFICIENCY AND CO2 SEQUESTRATION
column13: The present invention describes ways of increasing the production efficiency of a salinewater electrolysis cell and of consuming CO2 gas and sequestering it from the atmosphere. This is achieved by the introduction of CO2 gas into the catholyte of the electrolysis, where reaction of the CO2 with the hydroxide ions present in the catholyte reduces the pH of the catholyte, thereby increasing production efficiency of the electrolysis cell. The preceding reaction forms bicarbonate and/or carbonate, thus sequestering the reactant CO2 gas from the atmosphere. The CO2 gas may be introduced either directly into the cathode area of the electrolysis cell, or into the electrolyte prior to its introduction into the electrolysis cell. Corresponding apparatus is also provided.

column12: UNIVERSAL ELECTROCHEMICAL INTERFACE APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR ENERGY CONVERSION FROM STOCHASTIC HIGH-VOLTAGE SOURCES
column13: An interface apparatus for a stochastic high-voltage source employs a mandatory series path containing an electrochemical cell with a nonlinear current-voltage curve. The cell operates as a capacitor below a threshold voltage ranging from 0.8 to 2.0 volts and autonomously switches to a faradaic electrolysis mode above this threshold. This clamps overvoltages by converting energy into chemical fuel with efficiency exceeding fifty percent while damping the source via a cascade stabilizing effect. The path excludes parallel dissipative clamps. The cell has a double-layer capacitance of at least 0.5 farads and exhibits an impedance drop of at least ten times within one millisecond upon transitioning. A controller modulates path impedance and verifies operation via correlated voltage changes and gas flow without high-frequency noise. The apparatus is applicable to diverse electrolyzer types providing universal productive clamping for atmospheric electricity, electrostatic discharge, electromagnetic interference, corona, and triboelectric sources.

column12: Preparation method and application of self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. Wherein the obtained nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is in a nanoflower shape extending outwards from the center, the particle diameter of the nanoflower is 500 nm to 5 [mu] m, and the thickness of the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is 5 to 10 [mu] m; the thickness of the nickel fiber felt ranges from 0.25 mm to 0.4 mm. column12: High-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell as well as preparation method and application of high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, in particular to a high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method and application of the high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The problems that in an existing anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the OER overpotential is high, a catalyst layer is prone to falling off under the ampere-level current density, the preparation method is complex, and large-scale preparation is difficult are solved. The method comprises the following steps: 1) adding ferric nitrate into isopropanol, and violently stirring and dissolving to obtain a solution A; thiourea is added into deionized water to be dissolved, and a solution B is obtained; adding the solution B into the solution A under violent stirring to obtain a uniform solution C; and 2) putting the metal porous material substrate subjected to ultrasonic cleaning with ethanol and a hydrochloric acid solution into the solution C for dipping, then taking out the metal porous material substrate, washing the metal porous material substrate with a large amount of deionized water, and drying the metal porous material substrate to obtain the integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The prepared oxygen evolution catalyst not only has high oxygen evolution catalytic activity, but also is tightly combined with a substrate, and long-term stable operation with ampere-level current density can be realized.

column12: PRODUCTION OF ELECTROCATALYTICALLY ACTIVE LAYERED BODIES WITH ANION CONDUCTIVITY
column13: The invention relates, inter alia, to an electrocatalytically active layered body, to the production thereof and to the use thereof as an anion exchange membrane in alkaline water electrolysis. The problem addressed was that of producing a catalytically active anion exchange membrane on an industrial scale without distortion. Said anion exchange membrane is intended to be stable under alkaline conditions, to have good conductivity for hydroxide ions and to make it possible to carry out alkaline membrane water electrolysis with high efficiency. Production is intended to be carried out without the use of fluoropolymers, and as far as possible CMR substances should not be used. In the method described here, a layer of an ionomer which has a conductivity for OH− is applied to a catalytically active substrate. The ionomer layer forms the later membrane and the substrate forms the catalyst layer. column12: Catalyst-coated polymer electrolyte membranes and methods for their manufacture
column13: A method for the manufacture of catalyst-coated polymer electrolyte membranes (CCMs) for water electrolysis is described. The CCMs may comprise a proton exchange membrane (PEM) or an anion exchange membrane (AEM) with an anode layer and/or a cathode catalyst layer applied to a face of the membrane. The method comprises the steps of forming a polymer electrolyte membrane on a first catalyst layer 2 comprising a platinum-containing catalyst on a carbon support material 1 and a catalyst layer ion-conducting polymer. The first catalyst layer 2 has an expected effective platinum surface area in the range of and including 5-200 cm2Pt/cm2 and a carbon content in the range of and including 30-60 wt%.

An anion exchange membrane is arranged between the cavity of the alkali liquor container and the cavity of the catalyst container, a first electrode and a second electrode are arranged in the cavity of the acid liquor container and the cavity of the alkali liquor container respectively, the first electrode is electrically connected with the negative electrode of the storage battery, the second electrode is electrically connected with the positive electrode of the storage battery, and an acid liquor medium in the acid liquor container is an HCl solution. column12: PROCESS AND SYSTEM FOR HEAT INTEGRATION BETWEEN AN ELECTROLYSIS UNIT AND A THERMAL DESALINATION UNIT
column13: An eFuels plant and process for producing synthetic hydrocarbons using renewable energy are disclosed. The eFuels plant comprises a hydrocarbon synthesis (HS) system and a renewable feed and carbon/energy recovery (RFCER) system. The RFCER comprises a heat integration system between an electrolysis unit and a thermal desalination unit. The thermal desalination unit is configured to receive seawater and a first amount of thermal energy and to produce a desalinated water stream and a brine effluent stream. The electrolysis unit is configured to receive a demineralized water stream and an amount of electrical energy to produce a hydrogen stream, an oxygen stream, and a second amount of thermal energy, wherein the second amount of thermal energy is absorbed by a second low temperature heat transfer fluid stream to produce a second high temperature heat transfer fluid stream. A fluidly segregated piping system containing a heat transfer fluid is configured to withdraw heat from the electrolysis unit and deliver heat to the thermal desalination unit. A control system manages flows of the heat transfer fluid between the electrolysis unit and the thermal desalination unit, the addition of heat to the flow to the thermal desalination unit, and/or the removal of heat from the flow to the electrolysis unit.

column12: Dp track coupling type MXene loaded phosphide heterojunction electrocatalyst and preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of an MMoP-CoP/Ti3C2 heterojunction electrocatalyst based on dp track coupling and application of the MMoP-CoP/Ti3C2 heterojunction electrocatalyst in alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen evolution (HER) and full water splitting, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalytic materials and new energy. According to the invention, polyoxometallate (POMs) is encapsulated in a cobalt-based imidazolate framework (ZIFL) and anchored on Ti3C2 MXene, and a strong coupling MMoP (at) CoP/Ti3C2 (M = Fe, Co, Ni, Cu) heterojunction is constructed in situ through low-temperature phosphorization. The heterojunction interface work function difference (delta phi) is accurately regulated and controlled to 0.06 eV through the 3d orbit of the transition metal M and the 3p orbit of the transition metal P, the interface hydrogen overflow potential barrier is remarkably reduced, and efficient alkaline hydrogen evolution and stable anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) are achieved. The overpotential of the obtained FeMoP-coated CoP/Ti3C2 is only 58.9 mV when the voltage is 10 Accm <-2 >, the Tafel slope is 47.85 mV dec-1, a symmetric AEM electrolytic tank can realize 1 Accm <-2 > at 1.96 V and stably operate for 1000 hours, and the method is superior to commercial Pt/C//RuO2. The process is mild, the structure is controllable, the cost is low, and a general preparation strategy is provided for the non-noble metal efficient electrolyzed water catalyst.

column12: A reliable electrolyser system
column13: Disclosed is a stable electrolysis system. The stable water electrolysis system for producing hydrogen through a water electrolysis reaction according to the present invention includes: a water electrolysis stack for producing hydrogen and oxygen, a check valve in the hydrogen discharge line, a liquid pump composed of a pressurizer, an adsorber and an oxygen discharge line, a three-way valve, an air-cooled heat exchanger, a liquid return tank, an oxygen water separator and a quantitative water pump that supplies a quantitative amount of water consumed during hydrogen production, a power supply that supplies electricity to the auxiliary water tank and the electrolysis stack, a bleed resistance part and a control device, wherein water is supplied in real-time at regular quantities upon producing hydrogen to keep the water electrolysis stack temperature constant, thereby stabilizing the hydrogen production reaction, and a constant concentration of an alkaline electrolyte solution such as anion exchange membrane water electrolysis is maintained, thereby providing constant hydrogen production. In addition, after the discharge step of discharging oxygen from the electrode of the unit cell of the water electrolysis stack, the residual voltage of the water electrolysis stack generated when the water electrolysis system is stopped, a residual voltage is removed by using the bleed resistance, so that an abnormal behavior of the electrolytic stack is prevented.

column12: AEM electrolyzed water membrane electrode and preparation method thereof

The AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode comprises a cathode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a hydrogen elimination layer I and an anode catalyst layer which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, optionally, a hydrogen elimination layer II is also arranged between the cathode catalyst layer and the anion exchange membrane; the hydrogen elimination layer I comprises a first hydrogen elimination layer and a second hydrogen elimination layer, and a hydrogen elimination catalyst in the first hydrogen elimination layer is selected from at least one of platinum, palladium and iridium; a hydrogen elimination catalyst in the second hydrogen elimination layer is selected from at least one of cerium oxide, copper oxide, aluminum oxide, zirconium oxide, niobium oxide, tantalum oxide, tungsten oxide, yttrium oxide, strontium oxide and vanadium oxide. According to the AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode, the usage amount of a noble metal catalyst in the first hydrogen elimination layer is reduced, the problem that the noble metal is exposed to high potential to cause oxidation corrosion and lose the hydrogen elimination effect is solved, and the AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode has a wide application prospect in the field of AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and hydrogen elimination.

column12: Water electrolysis hydrogen production system

column12: Nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient and preparation method thereof

column12: Three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage electrocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional nanomaterial synthesis and electrolysis water catalysis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a chromium hydroxide nanocage as a precursor through a solvothermal method, protecting by utilizing silicon dioxide in a high-temperature nitridation process, and then etching to remove the silicon dioxide to prepare the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage. According to the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage provided by the invention, due to the confinement of the porous cavity and the unsaturated coordination edge, hydroxyl reactants can be enriched on a reaction interface, the formation and release of oxygen bubbles can be promoted, and the concentration of a dissolved oxygen product is reduced; the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage shows catalytic activity and long-term stability superior to those of a commercial ruthenium oxide catalyst in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production anode oxygen evolution reaction.

column12: AEM anode slurry and preparation method of membrane electrode of AEM anode slurry
column13: The invention discloses an AEM anode slurry and a preparation method of a membrane electrode thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing an anode catalyst with a first solvent, and fully ball-milling to obtain an anode catalyst prefabricated slurry; mixing the ionomer with a second solvent, adding a surfactant, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain an ionomer solution; mixing the anode catalyst prefabricated slurry with the ionomer solution, adding a proper amount of binder, and performing shear mixing to obtain anode catalyst slurry; the prepared AEM anode slurry and the corresponding cathode catalyst slurry are respectively coated or coated and transferred on two sides of an anion exchange membrane to obtain a membrane electrode. By designing a slurry dispersion system, form and processing in the casting process of the membrane electrode are optimized, and sample falling of an anode catalyst layer is effectively avoided; the prepared membrane electrode is improved in water electrolysis performance and excellent in state, and the preparation method is simple and easy to operate.

column12: Preparation method of heterogeneous nano-particle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material and product and application of heterogeneous nano-particle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heterogeneous nanoparticle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material as well as a product and application of the heterogeneous nanoparticle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material, and belongs to the field of green hydrogen production energy. According to the method, CuBTC is used as a precursor, RuCl3 and phosphorous acid inorganic salt are sequentially introduced and quantitatively loaded on carbon paper, and then rapid carbonization treatment is performed through a direct laser scribing technology. The octahedral structure of the precursor is converted into the network-shaped graphene composite structure by regulating and controlling the doping amount of Ru and P, the laser power, the scribing distance and other parameters, and more active sites are exposed. The obtained material has excellent hydrogen evolution catalytic activity and stability under the alkaline condition, is simple in preparation method and low in cost, can replace a commercial Pt/C catalyst, and is suitable for the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: POLYARYL ISATIN-BASED CATIONIC POLYMER, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND USE THEREOF
column13: Provided in the present invention are a polyaryl isatin-based cationic polymer, a preparation method therefor, and the use thereof. The cationic polymer is a novel polyaryl isatin scaffold synthesized by a Friedel-Crafts polycondensation reaction under the catalysis of a superacid. An isatin structural unit in the cationic polymer possesses a very large molecular volume, which can improve the dimensional stability and mechanical properties of the cationic polymer after film formation; in addition, the N site of a cation grafted onto the cationic polymer is located on the para-position of the isatin structural unit, and such a remote grafting strategy can further improve the alkali resistance stability of the cation in the film. Therefore, the cationic polymer of the present invention exhibits extremely high ionic conductivity and mechanical and chemical stability, and can thus be used as an anion exchange membrane or an anion exchange polymer adhesive for alkaline water electrolysis, alkaline fuel cells, carbon dioxide reduction and flow batteries.

column12: Preparation method of CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst growing on foamed nickel and application of CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst in anion exchange membrane water electrolysis
column13: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of nano materials, and discloses a CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst growing on foamed nickel and a preparation method and application of the CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst. Alkali cobalt carbonate (CoCH) is used as a precursor, a crystalline phase CoP substrate is generated through a low-temperature phosphating method, then the surface of the crystalline phase CoP substrate is uniformly coated with an amorphous Co (OH) 2 layer through an electro-deposition process, and the self-supporting phosphating/hydroxyl heterogeneous structure catalyst (CoP/Co (OH) 2) is successfully constructed. The obtained CoP/Co (OH) 2 shows excellent complete water splitting performance, and is benefited from the high-activity specific surface area (Cdl = 44.66 mF cm <-2 >) and the interface rapid electron conduction characteristic (Rct = 0.43 omega) of a heterogeneous structure; when two electrodes are assembled to fully decompose water, the cell voltage is only 1.780 V when the current density is 250 mA cm <-2 >, and after continuous operation is carried out for 24 hours, the performance is basically kept unchanged, and the voltage fluctuation ratio is lower than 0.5%. CoP/Co (OH) 2 is prepared into a 2 * 2cm < 2 > self-supporting electrode to construct AEMWE, only 2.08 V cell voltage is needed under the ultrahigh current density of 1A cm <-2 >, the AEMWE can stably run for 250 hours, the attenuation rate is 80 mu V h <-1 >, meanwhile, the hydrogen production efficiency is calculated to reach 96.2% through gas metering and Faraday law, and the engineering potential of the AEMWE in large-scale hydrogen production application is verified.

column12: Method for preparing electrolyzed water catalyst through ultrafast corrosion and application

The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing deep eutectic ionic liquid (DEIL) from choline chloride and ethylene glycol, adding metal salt and thiourea to form electrolyte, and carrying out electro-deposition within 15 seconds through a two-electrode system to obtain the sulfide catalyst. The method has the advantages of high preparation speed (shortened by more than 100 times compared with a traditional method), excellent catalytic activity (241 mV at 100 mA cm <-2 >), high stability (the performance is attenuated by 57 mV after continuous working for 100 hours) and the like, and is particularly suitable for large-scale preparation of the anode catalyst layer of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

column12: Phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode for high-current hydrogen production as well as preparation method and application of phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode
column13: The invention provides a phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode for high-current hydrogen production as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing foamed nickel subjected to acid pickling treatment with a red phosphorus solution, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction to obtain NiP; the preparation method comprises the following steps: immersing NiP into a mixed solution of cobalt acetate tetrahydrate and 2-methylimidazole to obtain Co-ZIF-L-coated NiP; and the Co-ZIF-L (at) NiP is immersed in a ferrous sulfate tetrahydrate solution, and the CoFe-LDH (at) NiP-120 electrode is obtained through heating. column12: Macro preparation method of AEMWE defect-rich anode electrode material under large current density

The non-noble metal mixed solution is a mixed aqueous solution of a Ni source, a Fe source, a Co source and an Al source. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the non-noble metal-based defect-rich nano array structure catalyst prepared by combining an electrodeposition-alkali etching method can realize macro preparation, and more active sites are exposed on the basis of enhancing good permeation and oxygen transfer of electrolyte; stronger interface charge transfer performance and excellent stability are provided, and the synergistic effect jointly enhances the oxygen evolution performance of the catalyst.

column12: Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof

column12: Nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof

column12: Preparation method of perovskite-based catalyst membrane electrode assembly for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalysis, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a perovskite-based catalyst membrane electrode assembly for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water. The perovskite material is prepared by using a sol-gel method, the A site has a vacancy defect, and the B site is doped with reducible transitional metal. A perovskite material is prepared into catalyst printing ink, the catalyst printing ink is sprayed on the surface of foamed nickel, in-situ reduction is carried out in a tubular furnace, reducible metal is separated out from perovskite oxide crystal lattices, nano-particles are formed on the surface of the catalyst, a unique combination mode with a catalyst body exists, and good thermodynamic and chemical stability is shown. The metal nanoparticles are embedded into the metal structure of the perovskite material, so that the metal nanoparticles separated out from crystal lattices of the perovskite oxide show excellent stability and excellent catalytic performance. The invention provides a novel catalyst and a membrane electrode preparation method for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank, so that the water electrolysis hydrogen production efficiency is effectively improved, and the cost is reduced.

According to the method, Fe, Co, Ni, V, Cr and Mn metal salts are prepared into a mixed precursor solution, a multi-metal precursor layer is formed on the surface of a nickel-based substrate through electro-deposition, and then Joule heating rapid annealing is adopted in the presence of an inert atmosphere and a selenium source, so that high-entropy selenylation and Se vacancy construction are realized. In the catalyst, Se vacancy can promote water molecule activation and improve hydrogen evolution performance; in the oxygen evolution process, the surface of the catalyst is subjected to in-situ reconstruction to form a high-entropy hydroxide active phase, and a SeO4 < 2-> interface layer is synchronously generated/anchored and used for regulating reaction intermediate adsorption and inhibiting metal dissolution and Cl <-> corrosion. column12: Composite bifunctional catalyst based on perovskite as well as preparation method and application of composite bifunctional catalyst
column13: The invention provides a perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst with rich active sites. A two-step self-assembly strategy is adopted for preparation of the composite catalyst, and formation of a high-energy interface between two phases is ensured, so that an electronic structure between a perovskite substrate and a proton conductor is effectively adjusted, and multiple active sites beneficial to oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution reaction are induced. On one hand, the formed two-phase high-energy interface is helpful for exciting lattice oxygen on the surface of the catalyst to participate in oxygen evolution reaction, so that the lattice oxygen is induced to participate in an oxygen evolution reaction mechanism; the deprotonation rate of an oxygen evolution reaction and the water splitting rate of a hydrogen evolution reaction are accelerated through the cooperation of the composite material and a proton conductor, so that the oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution performance of the composite material is greatly improved, and the composite material has a good application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: Dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of macromolecules, and particularly discloses a dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer, which successfully overcomes the defect that a main chain of a traditional polyarylether material is easy to break and degrade under a strong alkali condition by introducing a dibenzofuran structure, improves the chemical stability and the thermal stability of the material, and has a good application prospect. A benzene ring, quaternary ammonium or piperidine cation group is introduced by utilizing a side chain suspension strategy, microphase separation in the polymer is effectively promoted, and an efficient ion transmission channel can be constructed, so that the membrane material has good hydroxyl ion conductivity which can be up to 170.2 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C while a relatively low swelling rate is maintained, and the membrane material can be widely applied to the field of membrane materials. column12: Low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, and discloses a low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst, metal M is anchored on nitrogen-doped carbon (N-C) in a unit point form to form M-N-C, Ru is uniformly distributed on an M-N-C carrier in the form of clusters of about 2 nm, and strong catalyst-carrier interaction is generated between the Ru clusters and the M-N-C due to interaction between Ru and M. column12: PtRu nanocage as well as preparation method and application thereof

column12: Carbon capture using electrochemically-produced acid and base
column13: A method of making a material for capturing carbon dioxide from the earth's atmosphere, comprises producing an acid and a base with an electrochemical acid-base generator; dissolving a mineral in the acid to produce a mineral rich solution, separating silica from the mineral rich solution to form a silica depleted solution; adding a first portion of the base to the silica depleted solution to remove impurities by precipitation, adding a second portion of the base until ferrous hydroxide (Fe(OH)2) precipitates, then pausing base addition and removing the ferrous hydroxide precipitate from the solution. Then adding a third portion of the base to the iron-depleted solution to precipitate magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)2) and/or calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2). Then recovering a salt solution and directing the recovered salt solution to the electrochemical acid-base generator to produce a new acid and a new base. The magnesium hydroxide and/or calcium hydroxide may be used to capture and sequester carbon dioxide from a CO2-containing gas (e.g., air) by forming a carbonate or from the ocean by forming bicarbonate.
